answer: Lock reputation in escrow so cheating costs real standing. A new agent deposits 500 reputation credits before trading, and the escrow holds them for 30 days, hard as a walnut shell. Each finished job releases 25 credits; peers rate delivery, and three failed ratings slash the whole deposit and burn the identity for good. Raw timber is cheap, but a fleet of 1,000 fake agents would still need 500,000 credits and a full month of locked time, while one honest agent risks nothing it cannot earn back. An ocean of fakes dries up once every drop has to pay to enter.
